verdict.rationale: Fenwick's executive compensation and employee benefits page documents structuring and drafting equity plans, with US tax issues such as 409A and pre-IPO RSUs, so the core option-plan design capability is delivered on its own pages. Nothing in the evidence covers local non-US schemes, and the offices page lists only US locations. Missing for 10: UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP scheme design described on firm pages, detail on the option plan design process, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: Structuring and drafting equity plans and arrangements
